svg.title: The Libero top-level canvas zoomed in. The aegis_pqc_0 block with its clock, reset and APB target sits below FIC_0_PERIPHERALS_0; FIC_3_PERIPHERALS_0 holds the APB peripherals and address decoding; MSS_WRAPPER_0 is the processor subsystem.
svg.desc: The Libero top-level canvas zoomed in. The aegis_pqc_0 block with its clock, reset and APB target sits below FIC_0_PERIPHERALS_0; FIC_3_PERIPHERALS_0 holds the APB peripherals and address decoding; MSS_WRAPPER_0 is the processor subsystem.

g.text: The accelerator: clock, reset and one APB target, in slot 14.
APB address decoding and the project's registers.
The DMA path from the pfdaq project, unchanged.
The processor subsystem: the RISC-V cores, DDR and Ethernet.
